lines.1: 「Everyone, final exams are finally here. Fight with everything you have.」
lines.3: 「Oh, how terrifying. I cannot bring myself to say it.」
lines.4: 「Well, you can kiss summer vacation goodbye. And if you resist, you'll be expelled.」
lines.6: After our homeroom teachers had thoroughly terrorized us--
lines.8: Ms. Inori won't speak to me at all in private.
lines.9: But for some reason, the more she runs, the more fired up I get.
lines.11: ...Though there is no English on the first day.
lines.12: I studied nothing but English, so I don't understand any of the other subjects.
lines.13: 「...Damn. The version of me in my fantasies would finish this test in a minute and breakdance on the desk like Superman. Reality is always cruel.」
lines.14: 「Well, this is about what I expected... Ah, great. Am I headed for remedial lessons?」
lines.15: 「I don't need brains. I need instinct! I'll score points through instinct!」
lines.16: My childhood friends were struggling badly.
lines.18: 「Let's see, this goes here... This one is pretty easy.」
lines.19: As usual, the top students made it look effortless.
lines.21: 「Well... I still understand quite a lot of it!」
lines.25: Tomorrow is finally the main event: English.
lines.27: 「Ha. Vocabulary cards feel rather old-fashioned these days.」
lines.29: 「Hey, it's dangerous if you don't watch where you're--and she's gone.」
lines.30: 「Let's see... structurally... in terms of structure...」
lines.35: 「Class 2-A, huh? After everything they did to us at the festival, she's got nerve showing her face here.」
lines.36: 「All right, let's surround her and bully her!」
lines.38: 「Aw, the girl from 2-A is getting bullied.」
lines.39: 「This class sure has a lot of warped personalities.」
lines.40: 「From an outsider's perspective, you're one of them.」
lines.41: 「That's cruel. I was going to come cook you something that builds stamina.」
lines.43: 「Now that you say that, I absolutely want to come.」
lines.45: 「Don't just brush me off... That's lonely, damn it.」
lines.46: 「Sorry. Once English is over, I'll give you all the attention you want.」
lines.48: She shows absolutely no reaction to me.
lines.49: But I have no time to let that shake me.
